notes.conventions: blur radius r -> Gaussian sigma = r/2, support ceil(3 sigma) (feather_kernel); backdrop blur weight k = shape alpha * layer opacity (Studio reading, Figma UNVERIFIED); vector coverage = round(255 * hits / n^2) with n = VectorResolution.aa_samples (default 4); image paint placement: Folio transform maps unit image square -> unit square of the geometry bounding box; FILL/FIT/TILE require identity transform and rotation 0
